An''' [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]]''' served as the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the planet [[Begeren]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. He was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by [[Darth Thanaton|Teneb Kel]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], during the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Invasion of Begeren]].<ref name="tor" />
